source_rules: When examining an object with a desklamp, turn on the desklamp before examining the object.
When an object must be examined with a light source and the source is not visible on the target surface, examine the target and check other locations (drawers, dressers) for the light source.
When an object must be looked at under a light, first locate the light source, then move the object directly under it before attempting to look.
merge_list.new_rule: When an object must be examined under light, locate the source, open containers if needed, turn on the light, then examine the object.

source_rules: When an object must be cleaned and placed, do not waste time opening empty containers before checking countertops for the object.
When the target object must be found, never open cabinets or drawers first; scan the bathtubbasin and countertops first.
merge_list.new_rule: When an object must be cleaned and placed, scan countertops and basins first, then clean with the appliance and place it.

source_rules: When two objects must be retrieved and placed, search visible surfaces first before opening closed containers.
When multiple objects must be collected and placed, examine surfaces for them before opening storage, and re-examine surfaces after taking objects.
merge_list.new_rule: When retrieving multiple objects to place, search surfaces first, re-check after collection, then open containers if needed.

source_rules: When a task requires a clean object, clean it at sinkbasin before placing it in the target.
When an object must be cleaned and placed, do not waste time opening empty containers before checking countertops for the object.
When the target object must be found, never open cabinets or drawers first; scan the bathtubbasin and countertops first.
merge_list.new_rule: When an object must be cleaned and placed, search countertops and basins first, clean with sinkbasin, then place in target.

source_rules: When the target is a countertop, search cabinets first to find the object if not visible there.
When a cabinet is closed, go to a drawer or countertop to find the object instead of opening the cabinet.
merge_list.new_rule: If a container is closed, check drawers or countertops before opening it to find the object.
